file_index: of 13 libcob source files (smallest-first pass, < 70 functions)
statement: cobgetopt.c — GnuCOBOL's vendored GNU getopt_long (originally GNU C Library / gnulib) — ported function-for-function into gnucobol-rs. All 4 functions have a named Rust counterpart, confirmed by doxygen's preprocessed C parse (DOXYGEN.PARITY 4/4) and the awk inventory (LIBCOB.PARITY 4/4). Not clean-room: an openly-licensed, provenance-documented, oracle-verified Rust port of the admitted GnuCOBOL 3.2 command-line option scanner.

oracle.upstream: GnuCOBOL 3.2.0 (Free Software Foundation, Inc.); cobgetopt.c from the GNU C Library / gnulib

commit_range.first: (this batch) port the GNU getopt_long scanner (CobGetopt) 1:1

coverage.inventory_confirmed_by: doxygen preprocessed C parse (4 <memberdef kind=function>; DOXYGEN-PARITY.md cobgetopt.c 4/4) + awk inventory (LIBCOB-PARITY.md 4/4) + C-side grep (exactly 4 top-level definitions)
rust_modules: crates/gnucobol-rs/src/cobgetopt.rs (CobGetopt: new + cob_getopt_long_long + process_long_option + getopt_initialize + exchange + Ptr/OptionDef model)
coverage.state_model: The C file-static globals (optind/optarg/opterr/optopt/nextchar/ordering/first_nonopt/last_nonopt/getopt_initialized) become explicit CobGetopt fields (no global mutable state, #![forbid(unsafe_code)]). The char* scan pointer nextchar becomes a (elem, off) index into the owned, permutable argv. The struct option int* flag is modelled as an opaque slot id recorded in flag_writes (GnuCOBOL's own long_options tables always pass flag = NULL).

differential_verification.note: All against the admitted GnuCOBOL 3.2 oracle's real cob_getopt_long_long (getopt_harness.c linked against the built libcob). FAIL=0.
differential_verification.scenario_coverage: short options (required/optional/missing args, clustering, unknown), the leading +/-/: ordering modes (REQUIRE_ORDER / RETURN_IN_ORDER / leading-':' silent), PERMUTE reordering, the '--' terminator, long options (exact / unique-abbreviation / ambiguous / '=arg' / separate-arg / no-arg-with-'='), getopt_long_only (single-dash long + short fallback), and the '-W foo' convenience form. The compared stream is the per-call (return, optarg, optind, optopt) tuple; opterr forced to 0 on both sides.
differential_verification.self_contained: 6 in-crate unit tests (cargo test) cover the same semantics without the oracle.

non_claims: stderr diagnostic TEXT is not part of the court (opterr is forced to 0); the port emits the same messages but only the parse result tuple is differentially verified.

The struct option int* flag write-through is modelled as a recorded (slot, val) pair rather than a raw pointer store; GnuCOBOL's own long_options tables never use a non-NULL flag, so this path is exercised only by a unit test, not the oracle sweep.
POSIXLY_CORRECT is read from the process environment exactly as the C does; the sweep does not set it.
